• Ethos should target early-stage developers in Spain amid a massive data centre planning boom to secure design consultancy roles before approvals finalise.
• Global data centre spending doubling to $2.1 trillion by 2028 creates substantial new opportunities for Ethos to secure early-stage consultancy contracts.
• Increased capital expenditure for Zaragoza data centre projects signals massive M&E and sustainability design needs ahead of upcoming planning approvals.
• Ethos can position its energy compliance expertise to guide data centre developers through Spain's new regulatory requirements early in the design stage.
• Ethos can leverage its sustainability and energy expertise to pitch green engineering services for Nordic data centre expansions and renewable energy targets.

• Eight new data centre and lab planning or design tenders are available this week, including technical design, feasibility, and advisory services.
• Tenders feature regional upgrades, new data centre construction, and AI data centre projects across various locations.
